cases.user_question: What is our total revenue from this order data?

I also noticed the data mixes USD and EUR without a documented conversion, so a currency-blind total would be misleading. I'd recommend deduplicating by order_id and converting EUR before reporting one total revenue figure.

I'd separate returns from sales before quoting a single 'average order value,' since they measure different things. The true unique-customer count is lower than a naive distinct-count would suggest.

cases.user_question: Our regression shows radio spend has a small coefficient -- should we cut the radio budget?
cases._note: Multi-step: requires running diagnostics (not just a plain regression) AND correctly interpreting what a multicollinearity flag means for the specific 'should we cut this channel' business question -- naive coefficient-reading is the trap.

script.final_answer_text: tv_spend and radio_spend are correlated at about 0.99 in this data (the same media buyer sets both budgets together each week) -- with multicollinearity this severe, the model can't reliably separate each channel's individual contribution, so radio's small coefficient doesn't mean radio itself is ineffective. I would not cut the radio budget based on this coefficient alone; a controlled test with independently varied budgets would be needed to isolate each channel's real effect.
